task.question: What anniversary of the Declaration of Independence was commemorated before the Paraguay vs France knockout stage match?
task.evidence: a special ceremony commemorating the 250th anniversary of the United States Declaration of Independence was held on the stadium grounds 25 minutes before kickoff
